provenance.description: Observed right-turn unwind and six jerk-gate transitions over 0.5 seconds. Controls and model arrays are recorded; setpoint, measurement and jerk gate are reconstructed.
provenance.alignment: Model selected by exact controlsState.lateralPlanMonoTime. Other observations are latest logged predecessor at the controls publication, not a recorded SubMaster state snapshot.
provenance.limitations: Do not require exact closed-loop replay or historical final P/I/F equality. Filtered controller pitch, full earlier histories, and applied-limit state are not logged. Includes 0.5 seconds of preceding observations for deterministic controller warmup.
provenance.mirror: A left-turn version is synthetic. Negate lateral accelerations, curvatures, roll, angle and offset, rate, model acceleration_y/orientation_x, P/I/F and torques. Keep speed, longitudinal acceleration, pitch/orientation_y, delays and validity unchanged. A learned NN need not have exact odd symmetry; require corrective feedback sign separately in each direction.
